backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence describing a requirement to replace a thank‑you screen sentence with a provided custom message in App.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of key frontend components and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and global style resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app through main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component toggling between the apology interaction and the forgiveness screen with animations and a custom message.
frontend/src/components/ApologyInteracti: Interactive component showing Yes/No buttons where No moves randomly and prompts escalate.
frontend/src/components/FallingEmojis.ts: Continuously spawns and animates falling sad emojis after forgiveness.
frontend/src/components/HeartsBurst.tsx: Creates a short-lived animated burst of hearts when forgiveness is granted.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing because no backend queries are required.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, custom OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes, global styles, and animations for hearts, floating, and falling emojis.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, extended animations, typography, container queries, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, features, and notes for an interactive apology app including behavior, animations, and final message requirements.
